All 8 review-requested UI elements are present and animating: (1) greeting 'Good morning, Envirolytics' (matches /^Good (morning|afternoon|evening|night), /), (2) header-bell + header-avatar testIDs visible+clickable in top-right, (3) dashboard-hero card renders with count-up hero-online='5', hero-total='5', animated hero-ring donut arc with hero-ring-pct='100%' centered, (4) mini stats row DWLR/Flow/Offline/Alerts all with pastel dots + count-up values (1 DWLR, 2 FLOW, 0 OFFLINE, 0 ALERTS), (5) LIVE DATA section header pill dashboard-live-count reads '3 / 5 LIVE' — pastel-green pill with LED dot, (6) 5 LiveDeviceCards render (live-card-Flowmeter_1, live-card-Flowmeter_2, live-card-DWLR_*, plus 2 DO-analyzer cards) — Flowmeter cards show FLOW '11122.270 m³/h' + TOTAL '333496.000 m³' chips with the requested 3-decimal precision AND the pulsing LIVE/STALE/SILENT LED text renders in the correct green/amber/red, (7) staggered fade+slide entrance visible in screenshots, (8) 20-second auto-refresh confirmed — after wait_for_timeout(22000) hero+live-count still present, still 5 cards, ZERO duplication, ZERO memory-crash, no console.error added. Backend regression 4/4 PASS: GET /api/ 200 ok/envirolytics-mobile-backend, GET /api/health 200 with int poll_interval_s, POST /api/admin/run-auto-deactivate 200 {status:scheduled}, POST/GET /api/email-subscriptions round-trips with weekly:true. All 5 protected tabs navigate without crash (/devices, /quality, /reports, /alerts, /profile). Upstream /api/instrument-registry/last-data returns 405 as expected — api.lastData() catches it and the client-side fallback (instruments + dwlrLatest + flowmeterLatest + offline) synthesises the 5-device grid successfully (visible in screenshots). Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Cosmetic web-only warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents) unchanged from prior iterations — no user impact. ONE FUNCTIONAL BUG FOUND: tapping a LiveDeviceCard does NOT navigate to /device/[id] on RN-Web preview — after clicking live-card-Flowmeter_1 and waiting 2.5s the URL remains /dashboard. Root cause is DOM stacking: the pressable View is rendered as the first child of Animated.View with StyleSheet.absoluteFill, so on RN-Web the flex-laid-out head/chips/footer siblings paint ON TOP and swallow the click before it reaches the responder overlay. On real iOS/Android this would still work (native responder system is Z-agnostic) but on the web preview it silently no-ops.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the card does NOT navigate to /device/[id] on RN-Web preview. The pressable overlay (View with onStartShouldSetResponder / onResponderRelease) is inserted as the FIRST child of the outer Animated.View with StyleSheet.absoluteFill, but the head/chips/footer siblings are laid out AFTER it in DOM order and paint on top on the web. Touch/click events land on non-pressable children, so the overlay's onResponderRelease never fires. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LiveDeviceCard.tsx:102-109. Fix: replace the overlay pattern with a real TouchableOpacity/Pressable wrapping the entire card content, or move the absolute-fill overlay to the LAST child AND set pointerEvents='box-only' on it so it captures children's events. Reproduction: login → dashboard → click any LiveDeviceCard → observe URL stays on /dashboard.

rca_of_issue: LiveDeviceCard tap-to-navigate no-op on RN-Web. RCA: LiveDeviceCard.tsx renders the interactive layer as a plain <View style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} onStartShouldSetResponder={...} onResponderRelease={onPress}/> inserted as the FIRST child of the outer Animated.View, followed by <LinearGradient>, <View head>, <View chips>, <View footer>. In React Native Web, siblings are laid out in normal document flow and later siblings paint on top of earlier absolute-positioned siblings (identical z-index). Mouse/touch events therefore hit the head/chips/footer (which don't participate in the responder system) and never bubble to the overlay's onStartShouldSetResponder. Reproduction: login → /dashboard → wait for cards → click any live-card-* → URL remains /dashboard. Mitigation options (in order of simplicity): (a) move the responder <View> to be the LAST child of Animated.View so it paints on top; (b) wrap the whole content in a Pressable/TouchableOpacity with onPress={onPress} instead of the overlay pattern (recommended — preserves press-scale animation via onPressIn/onPressOut); (c) add pointerEvents='none' to head/chips/footer to force events through — hacky, breaks any future nested interactivity.
